description: This file contains an abstract class 'ResourceSelectorTestRunner' with methods to test resource selection logic, including ensuring non-repetition, handling large selections, and avoiding re-selection of excluded resources, primarily used for unit testing resource selector implementations in Orleans streaming.

classes.name: ResourceSelectorTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing testing methods for resource selector implementations in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the resource selector cycles through all resources without repetition when starting with an empty selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitely
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a large number of selections does not result in an infinite loop and all resources are correctly selected.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelections
methods.description: Checks that the resource selector does not re-select resources that are already excluded.
